notes.title: New game from the Inspector Waffles' creator!
notes.content: [p]Well, "new game" ... It all started in 2019 when I did a small project called Antenna Dilemma, just before I made Inspector Waffles (this one). I put on Antenna Dilemma on hold for quite some time, and now, I'm going to finish and release it :)[/p][p][/p][p]If you don't know, Antenna Dilemma is a witty point-and-click adventure game in which you'll follow the story of C432632, a finicky grey cube that sure doesn't want to miss his favorite TV show.[/p][p align="start"]In a media-driven society in which nothing else matters but TV, our hero is about to have a life-changing encounter. Gone are the sofa and the remote control: for the first time of his life, C432632 is about to break out of his routine and set off, against his will, on an epic adventure.[/p][p align="start"][/p][p align="start"] [url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3853730/Antenna_Dilemma"]You can add Antenna Dilemma to your wishlist here[/url].[/p][p][/p][p]If you haven't, you can play the prologue, free on Steam.[/p][p][/p][p]Thanks for your support,[/p][p][/p][p]Yann[/p]

notes.title: Inspector Waffles Early Days - Coming 2024
notes.content:
Inspector Waffles Early Days is a new game for PC in a retro pixel art style, and it's the prequel of this Inspector Waffles game. It will be released in 2024.


This time, follow Waffles in his first days as a Inspector and prove to everyone that you are more than just a rookie. Find clues, report to your partner and solve cases!

[list]
[*] Top-down adventure game with point-and-click mechanics, inspired by the classic Gameboy games like Pokemon and Zelda.
[*] 5 Full cases to solve! Bank heist, arson, robbery, murder... Something for every taste!
[*] Easter eggs, mysteries and old characters from the previous Inspector Waffles game!
[*] An exciting story that keeps you on the edge of your seat! Snowball is back, ready to do some new dirty tricks.
[/list]

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2614580/Inspector_Waffles_Early_Days/]You can add Early Days to your wishlist here[/url]. Demo will come very soon, with full support for Steam Cloud, Steam Input and Steam achievements :)

notes.title: 1.0.3: Workshop localization update!
notes.content:
Hi everyone,

Long time no see, but it doesn't mean I was drinking a pina colada with Waffles (I wasn't). 

I'm happy to share this new major update with 3 main new features:
[list]
[*] Workshop localization
[*] 16:10 resolutions compatibility
[*] Steam cloud saves
[/list]
I have to be honest with you, this is the probably the last big update for Inspector Waffles and from now I'm going to focus mostly on my next games. 

[h1]Workshop localization[/h1]

Some weeks ago, I found out that some non official localizations were available on Internet: it was a good surprise to see some players who were interested to make their own translations of my game. I helped them by creating a easier framework to include it in game. Fortunately, Steam lets devs to implement Steam workshop for community content.

Anyway, with this new feature, you'll be able to make the game in any language you want. If you are interested, I made an article which describes everything you need to know: https://steamcommunity.com/workshop/discussions/18446744073709551615/5135803832916502175/?appid=1055850

Big special thanks to Vinczei who helped a lot to test it. He also did an hungary translation, which is super nice. You can already download it as a workshop item.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34786718/f4e593d83d88ac28beab85d774ec8b8f3297d167.png[/img]

[h1]16:10 resolutions compatibility[/h1]

Finally you can play Inspector Waffles in 16:10 resolutions, all bugs related to these screen resolutions are now fixed.

[h1]Steam cloud saves[/h1]

Your save files are now stored in Steam cloud, you can now play through the game on different computers.


Thanks again for your feedbacks and support, and hope to share some news soon :)

-Yann

notes.title: INSPECTOR WAFFLES IS OUT!
notes.content:
Hello, Inspectors! We are so happy to announce that [i](drum roll please!)[/i]...

[h1]Inspector Waffles is now available![/h1]

[previewyoutube=j1mqUX3Nqj0;full][/previewyoutube]

What a journey it was! I've been working almost alone on Inspector Waffles for more than three years, and I'm very proud to be finally able to share it on Steam (and GOG, if you prefer DRM-free!). 

Thanks again to my amazing community who have helped so much with testing and feedback. There are over 300 of us in the [url=http://discord.golosogames.com][b]Discord[/b][/url] server, so please join in the fun! 

And one very important request: if you're enjoying the game, please [i]please[/i] please [h3]leave a review on Steam![/h3] It's so important and helps a lot with visibility -- it's a great way to encourage Steam to recommend the game to other players!

[h2]What next?[/h2]

A minor update will happen soon, mostly to fix some typos and optimize game performance. If you see any bugs, feel free to let me know in the [url=https://discord.com/invite/2GJe2EAb]Discord[/url]!

[h2]Sidequest merch[/h2]

You won a prize during the side quest contest? Congrats!
We're working as fast as we can to send your goodies, and they'll be on their way very soon. If case you missed the original contest announcement, here are the goodies we're sharing with contest winners!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34786718/aac6b7affc9895ac0df903fa526254c568c0c119.jpg[/img]

Thanks for your support, and have fun playing Inspector Waffles :)

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1055850/Inspector_Waffles/

Take care,

Yann from Goloso Games

notes.title: Devlog #02: New key art!
notes.content:
[h2][b]Hello Detectives![/b][/h2]

It's been another productive month for Inspector Waffles, so it's time for an update in Devlog #02! :)

[list]
[*] [h3]New Key Art![/h3]
You may have seen the recent update here on the Steam page: [b]there is fantastic new key art painted by the super-talented [url=https://twitter.com/Steemie]Em Stem[/url].[/b] They've done such a great job, and it's all such a perfect fit for the game atmosphere! If you like nice art, give Em a follow!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34786718/9785a1b921318758f8f960081a52e71affca62db.png[/img]

[*] [h3]New Cutscenes![/h3]
In addition to the aforementioned key art, [b]Em has been painting all new art for the Inspector Waffles' cutscenes[/b]. If you've played the demo, you might remember the previous intro cutscene that I made. Needless to say, Em's renditions are huge improvements :) Here are a couple screenshots from the updated version.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34786718/40ad07a27ab0d3e6bdf3591b2ea57da70802c173.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34786718/b49efc0f1ea03fb1ff085b1d76096987b36870fa.jpg[/img]
Every cutscene in the game will be painted in a similar style -- I can't wait to share!

[*] [h3]New Detective![/h3]
[b]Inspector Waffles doesn't have to go it alone. Unfortunately, his help comes in the feline embodient of the Peter principle: Patches, the gluttonous chief.[/b]

Hold your milkshake and stash your candies; when another murder is called in, it's Patches time to shine... er, stumble. Well, he'll do his best. But will you discover a new murdered? And is this case related to Fluffy's death? THE MYSTERY IS SO MYSTERIOUS!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34786718/3b47a8b7e7acc187e4f8df51ba79972eb0862651.gif[/img]

[*] [h3]New Locations![/h3]
[b]I've recently added the 50th unique location[/b] where Waffles will be able to investigate. Just to compare, the demo contains only seven rooms. The game gets bigger everyday! Development isn't over, but the finish line is in sight! :)

Here is a preview of one of the latest scenes I've made: Waffles drinking fresh milk in the bar.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34786718/0fbb8ae337d65ee862597e323a29f610e133047d.gif[/img]
[/list]

That's all for this update! A lot was accomplished in the past month, and if I can keep this pace, you can expect some great news for upcoming devlogs!

[h2]In the meantime, there is lots more news to share in the future, including some community events, so I'd really love for you to join our growing Discord![/h2]
[url=discord.gg/GJrnmFN][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34786718/819776f85adfab0ccacdc17b5619b1285ae915fc.png[/img][/url]

notes.title: Devlog #01: Welcome to the first update!
notes.content:
Hello Detectives!

Since the Summer Festival's demo, I've made lots of progress on [b]Inspector Waffles[/b] wanted to share and update with all of you!

[list]
[*] [h3]New dialogue box![/h3]
I wanted to add more life to the dialogue box, adding special effects to better capture emotions like sarcasm, fear, surprise, etc. Below is a sneak-peek example; if you have any good suggestions, please share in the comments!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34786718/d132e2affc881a9d6ddc5d2e03e402bef8e78213.gif[/img]

[*] [h3]Spotty and his scent-sniffing snout![/h3]
He's not present in the demo, so allow this to be my formal introduction of Spotty the Sniffer Dog; he'll have a very important role in the game. Inspector Waffles isn't sure about having a new sidekick though, not since what happened last time... but could Spotty change his mind? 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34786718/0aeb4afee766da65cd25399cc63ef546984939a3.gif[/img]

[*] [h3]Lots of new locations![/h3]
The game currently contains more than 40 unique locations/rooms. I wanted to share a couple screenshots (without any spoilers!) of some of these new locales where you'll be doing your sleuthing:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34786718/157eec36596037c47bd079a294891d5310e5dc62.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34786718/0fbb8ae337d65ee862597e323a29f610e133047d.gif[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34786718/d042c97f1ba4dfd14e7af2362186e93e928f3804.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34786718/99dbf44bcdb949711e8b25a1b7d08e731953861d.gif[/img]

[/list]

That's all for this first update. It's not a lengthy one, but I wanted to make this first post just to let you all know some of the things that have been happening lately.

[h2]There is lots more news to share in the future, including some community events, so I'd really love for you to join our growing Discord![/h2]
[url=discord.gg/GJrnmFN][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34786718/819776f85adfab0ccacdc17b5619b1285ae915fc.png[/img][/url]


[h3]Let's stay connected![/h3]
